items.source:
A functional interface to convert tool call results to a String that can be sent back
to the AI model.
items.translation: 一个功能接口，用于将工具调用结果转换为可返回给 AI 模型的字符串。

items.source: A functional interface to process a ToolExecutionException by either converting the error message to a String that can be sent back to the AI model or throwing an exception to be handled by the caller.
items.translation: 一个功能接口，用于处理 ToolExecutionException，方法是将错误消息转换为可返回给 AI 模型的字符串，或抛出由调用者处理的异常。

items.source: An exception thrown when a tool execution fails.
items.translation: 工具执行失败时抛出的异常。
